items.title: Saudis Aided Family of Engineer Accused of Bugging OpenAI, Prosecutors Say
items.summary: A Saudi military official paid for the OpenAI engineer’s wife and infant son to fly out of the United States a day after his arrest, according to a court filing. The Saudi government also offered to cover his bail.
